seo.title: Md. Al Amin Tusher — Investigative & Multimedia Journalist, Dhaka
seo.description: Md. Al Amin Tusher is an investigative and multimedia journalist in Dhaka, Bangladesh, reporting on infrastructure, fire safety, rivers and public-interest failures. Staff correspondent at Netra News.

hero.eyebrow: Dhaka, Bangladesh · Staff Correspondent, Netra News
hero.name: Md. Al Amin Tusher
hero.lead: I report on the systems that are supposed to keep people safe — building codes, embankments, river channels, welfare rolls — and what happens when they fail. Five years of field reporting, documents and data across Bangladesh.

work.heading: Investigations, data reporting and interactives
work.lead: Reported for Netra News, including document-based investigations and interactive data projects. Reporting and analysis are my own unless noted.

contact.heading: Working on a story I should know about?
contact.lead: Available for investigative assignments, commissions, fixing and collaborations in Bangladesh. Documents and tips welcome.
